questions.stem: According to the passage, what does the root word "struct-" come from and mean?
questions.evidence: It comes from the Latin word meaning “build.”
questions.explanation_ko: struct-는 라틴어에서 유래했으며 '짓다'라는 뜻이라고 나와 있습니다.

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT given as one of the common root words mentioned?
questions.evidence: A few other common root words include “bio" meaning life, “auto” meaning self, “pro” meaning before or in favor of, and “tele” meaning distance.
questions.explanation_ko: 본문에는 bio, auto, pro, tele가 언급되지만 photo는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.stem: What can be inferred from the fact that learning just 20 or 30 root words can expand a learner's vocabulary by hundreds of words?
options: Learning root words is a highly efficient way to build a large vocabulary.
Root words are only useful for advanced English learners.
Memorizing root words is less useful than memorizing whole words individually.
English has fewer root words than most other languages.
questions.evidence: by learning just 20 or 30 root words, you can expand your English vocabulary to include hundreds of new words
questions.explanation_ko: 20~30개의 어근만 배워도 수백 개의 새 단어로 어휘를 확장할 수 있다는 내용에서, 어근 학습이 매우 효율적인 어휘 학습법임을 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author explain how suffixes like "-ion," "-ing," "-ive," and "-ly" can be added to "struct" one by one?
options: To demonstrate how a single root word can generate many related words with different meanings and parts of speech
To argue that suffixes should never be used with root words
To explain the history of the Latin language
To criticize learners who use too many suffixes
questions.evidence: There are many other words that the base word “struct” produces.
questions.explanation_ko: 이 설명은 하나의 어근에서 여러 품사와 의미를 가진 단어들이 파생될 수 있음을 보여 주기 위한 것입니다.

questions.stem: In the passage, what does "comforting" mean in "it is comforting to know that learning root words can help"?
questions.evidence: it is comforting to know that learning root words can help a non-native speaker use English
questions.explanation_ko: comforting은 안심이 되거나 위안이 된다는 뜻입니다.

blanks.sentence_ko: 우리는 마치 유행이 지나가는 것처럼 관용구를 아주 많이 사용한다.
어근은 크고 새로운 단어를 작은 단위로 나누어 그 의미를 알아내는 데 도움을 줄 수 있다.
그래서 construct는 무언가를 짓거나 만들기 위해 여러 요소를 합친다는 뜻이다.
그러니 어근 하나, struct-만 알아도 영어 단어 최소 15개의 뜻을 더 잘 이해할 수 있게 된다.

key_points: English is difficult partly because of unpredictable spelling and pronunciation and many idioms, but learning root words can make vocabulary building easier.
A root word is the most basic form of a word, and prefixes, bases, and suffixes are all types of roots that appear at the beginning, middle, or end of a word.
Learning just 20 to 30 root words, most of which come from Greek or Latin, can help learners understand hundreds of English words.
The root 'struct-,' meaning 'build' in Latin, can combine with prefixes and suffixes to form words like construct, construction, constructive, destruction, and instruction.
main_idea: Learning a relatively small number of root words, along with common prefixes and suffixes, can help English learners understand hundreds of new words.
restate_sentence: Root words can help you to break down large, new words into smaller units to discover their meanings.
